snippet.title: Berserk B.I.T.S Launch Trailer!
snippet.description:
Berserk B.I.T.S is out NOW! 
Grab your Virtual Buddy (B.I.T) and dive into action to save the internet in this new Idle, Chip Collecting Auto-Battler that sits at the bottom of your screen! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2348540/Berserk_BITS/
